piper.en-us-lessac-medium.name: Piper Lessac (medium, en-US)
piper.en-us-lessac-medium.summary: Single-speaker U.S. English VITS neural text-to-speech voice for the Piper engine, trained from scratch on the Blizzard 2013 Lessac corpus.

license.notes: Upstream declares no SPDX identifier: the voice MODEL_CARD names only the Blizzard 2013 Lessac dataset license at the url above, whose text was not retrievable from the verification environment; Piper upstream adds that voices are 'intended for personal use and text to speech research only' and that it imposes no additional restrictions - review the dataset license before commercial use.

openwakeword.hey-jarvis.name: openWakeWord hey jarvis
openwakeword.hey-jarvis.summary: Wake-word model that scores 80 ms frames of 16 kHz mono audio for the spoken phrase "hey jarvis", run through openWakeWord's ONNX pipeline.

license.notes: Non-commercial only: the upstream repository's LICENSE file is Apache-2.0 but that covers the code, and openWakeWord's README licenses all included pre-trained models, this one among them, under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0.

openwakeword.hey-jarvis-tflite.name: openWakeWord hey jarvis (tflite)
openwakeword.hey-jarvis-tflite.summary: Wake-word model that scores 80 ms frames of 16 kHz mono audio for the spoken phrase "hey jarvis", run through openWakeWord's TensorFlow Lite pipeline. Same model as openwakeword.hey-jarvis, packaged for consumers that run tflite_runtime instead of onnxruntime.

license.notes: Non-commercial only: the upstream repository's LICENSE file is Apache-2.0 but that covers the code, and openWakeWord's README licenses all included pre-trained models, this one among them, under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0.

vosk.en-us-small-0.15.name: Vosk small (en-US, 0.15)
vosk.en-us-small-0.15.summary: Lightweight wideband U.S. English streaming speech-recognition model for the Vosk (Kaldi) engine, built for mobile and Raspberry Pi class devices. Some consumers also use it as a keyword-spotting wake-word engine.

license.notes: Stated in the License column of Alpha Cephei's model list for vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15. The archive itself ships no LICENSE file (only a README with 'Copyright 2020 Alpha Cephei Inc'), so the model list is the only upstream statement.

faster-whisper.small.name: faster-whisper small (multilingual)
faster-whisper.small.summary: Multilingual Whisper small speech-recognition checkpoint converted to CTranslate2 format for the faster-whisper engine. Transcribes with punctuation, casing and word-level timestamps.

license.notes: Read from the `license: mit` front matter of the model card (README.md) shipped inside the pinned revision, which is also what the Hugging Face API reports. The converted weights derive from OpenAI's Whisper, which is itself MIT-licensed.
